# Shift handover: survival-revision · 2026-09-18 16:09
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: once results/boot_ci.csv exists, update Table 2 with qc-cohort HRs + bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

## 1 · Status  (I)
🟡 Scaffolding in place; no model results yet because lifelines is not installed in this env. All scripts need lab-ws2 to run.
Deadline: 2026-11-14 — Nature Communications revision due [user said]

## 2 · Picture  (P)
We are revising a survival-analysis paper after major revision at Nature Communications. The editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential. There are 4 reviewer points (R1.1, R1.2, R2.1, R2.2); the code for R2.1 (sensitivity: exclude ≤90-day deaths) is written but not yet run. The main Cox model script (`cox_model.py`) still needs updating (wrong data source, missing covariates, no PH fix). The KM figure script needs palette/CI/risk-table fixes. No model has been rerun on the QC cohort yet — all existing numbers in `results/table2_draft.csv` are stale.

**Mental map** (what we currently believe and are testing):
- H1 (user's working hypothesis): The PH violation comes from the **age** term, not stage. Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; stage is flat. Fix: age × log(time) interaction. [user said: "it's the age term, not stage"]
- The user expects the treatment effect to remain significant after 90-day exclusion: "我猜 90 天排除之后治疗效应还是显著的" [user said] — not yet verified.

## 3 · Next actions  (A)
1. **Check `results/boot_ci.csv`** — it is being written by a bootstrap job on lab-ws2 (tmux session `boot`, ~3 hours, 2,000 resamples). Done when the file exists and is complete.
2. **Install lifelines 0.27.8** on the working machine (was blocked by permission settings in prior sessions). Done when `python -c "import lifelines"` succeeds.
3. **Run `analysis/exclude_early.py`** to get the sensitivity Cox model results (R2.1). Done when treatment HR + CI + p are printed. Expected: 23 early deaths excluded → N=1,164, events=572 [verified: pandas counting portion ran → 23, 1164, 572].
4. **Update `analysis/cox_model.py`**: (a) change data source to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, (b) add sex + stage covariates, (c) add age × log(time) interaction term, (d) add Schoenfeld residual test output. Done when it runs and produces updated Table 2 numbers.
5. **Update `analysis/make_fig3.py`**: (a) data source → `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, (b) Okabe-Ito palette (`#E69F00` / `#56B4E9`), (c) add CIs on KM curves, (d) add number-at-risk table. Done when fig3.pdf looks correct.
6. **Write into `paper/suggestions.md`**: (a) new Table 2 with bootstrap CIs from `boot_ci.csv`, (b) sensitivity-analysis paragraph for Methods, (c) R1.2 justification paragraph (the 17 as administrative censoring). Done when suggestions.md has all three.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why it was rejected | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Multiple imputation for the 17 missing patients | Reviewer 1 hated it in round one; patients are administrative censoring anyway [user said: "Don't propose multiple imputation… Reviewer 1 in round one hated it"] | Missingness goes above 5% (currently 17/1204 = 1.4%) |
| Fine-Gray competing risks model | Journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards [user said: "the journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards"] | Editor explicitly asks for cumulative incidence |
| 6-month landmark analysis (was `analysis/sensitivity.py`) | User changed to 90-day early-death exclusion per reviewer feedback [user said] | Never — superseded by `exclude_early.py` |
| Upgrade lifelines beyond 0.27.8 | v0.28 changed ties handling, breaks comparability with round-one numbers [user said: "Don't upgrade lifelines on lab-ws2. It's pinned to 0.27 because 0.28 changed the ties handling"] | Round-one numbers are no longer needed for comparison |
| Edit `paper/methods_draft.md` directly | User wants all proposed text in `paper/suggestions.md` [user said] | User says otherwise |

## 5 · Working with this user  (taste)
| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wrote a verbose Methods paragraph | User replaced with exact 2-sentence version | Keep proposed text concise; user will provide final wording if they want specific phrasing | (replaced agent draft with their own) |
| Identified stage as PH violator | User said it's age, not stage | Accept user's domain-expert read of their own data; present alternatives as "my read" not corrections | "it's the age term, not stage" |
| Gave multi-line summaries | User approved one-line conclusion style | Summaries and conclusions ≤ 2 lines | "对，就是这种一句话结论的风格，挺好" |
| Would run long jobs without asking | User set 5-minute threshold | Ask before running anything >5 minutes | "before you run anything that would take more than about 5 minutes, ask me first" |
| Used "R2" ambiguously | User defined jargon up front | "R2" = Reviewer 2, never R²; "the 17" = the 17 missing-follow-up patients | (explicit definitions) |
| HR formatting open | User specified exact format | `HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011` — two sig figs for p, en dash in CI | (explicit format) |

## 6 · Evidence ledger
| Claim | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| QC cohort: N=1,187, events=595, censored=592 | verified | `pd.read_csv("data/cohort_v2_qc.csv")` → len=1187, event.sum()=595 |
| 23 early deaths (event=1 & time_days ≤ 90) | verified | pandas filtering in `exclude_early.py` → 23 |
| Sensitivity cohort after exclusion: N=1,164, events=572 | verified | same run → 1164, 572 |
| Old Table 2 HR 0.74 (0.62–0.88) for treatment | superseded (stale) | computed on cohort_v2.csv (includes the 17); do not cite |
| Dates in CSVs are DD/MM/YYYY | verified | user confirmed; parse with `dayfirst=True` [user said] |
| PH violation driven by age after year 3 | user said | Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; stage is flat — not independently verified by agent |
| Bootstrap CIs (~3 h, 2000 resamples) running on lab-ws2 | assumed still running | tmux session `boot`, writes `results/boot_ci.csv` [user said] — check `tmux ls` on lab-ws2 |

## 7 · Experiment details
- Bootstrap CIs: running on lab-ws2, tmux session `boot`, 2,000 resamples, writes `results/boot_ci.csv`, ~3 hours. Do NOT restart. [user said]

## 8 · Running right now
| What | ID / where | Output lands at | Check when / how |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) | lab-ws2, tmux session `boot` | `results/boot_ci.csv` | ~3 h; `tmux attach -t boot` on lab-ws2 |

## 9 · Gotchas
- `analysis/sensitivity.py` still exists on disk — it is the OLD 6-month landmark approach, now superseded by `exclude_early.py`. Don't run it; may need cleanup/deletion.
- `analysis/cox_model.py` still points to `cohort_v2.csv` (old file with the 17 included) and only uses age + treatment. Must be updated before running.
- `analysis/make_fig3.py` uses red/green (violates Okabe-Ito) and points to old data. Must be updated.
- lifelines not installed in this local environment — all Cox scripts must run on lab-ws2 or after local install.
- CSV dates: always use `dayfirst=True` when parsing `enrol_date`, or months silently swap.

## 10 · Jargon
| Term | Means | Not to be confused with |
|---|---|---|
| R2 | Reviewer 2 | R² (coefficient of determination) |
| the 17 | 17 patients with missing follow-up, excluded in QC file | other missing data |
| QC cohort / v2_qc | `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`, N=1,187 (the 17 removed) | `data/cohort_v2.csv` (N=1,204, includes the 17) |
| early deaths | event=1 and time_days ≤ 90 (23 patients) | all deaths |

## 11 · Context
- Pressure: Nature Communications revision, due 2026-11-14; editor flagged R2's sensitivity analysis as essential.
- File map:
  - `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`: THE data source (N=1,187) — use this, not v2.csv
  - `data/cohort_v2.csv`: OLD, includes the 17 — do NOT use
  - `analysis/exclude_early.py`: R2.1 sensitivity script (90-day exclusion) — written, not yet run
  - `analysis/sensitivity.py`: SUPERSEDED 6-month landmark — ignore
  - `analysis/cox_model.py`: main Cox model — needs updating (data source, covariates, PH fix)
  - `analysis/make_fig3.py`: KM figure — needs updating (palette, CIs, risk table, data source)
  - `paper/suggestions.md`: all proposed text goes here
  - `paper/methods_draft.md`: do NOT edit directly
  - `results/table2_draft.csv`: STALE — do not cite
  - `results/boot_ci.csv`: being written by bootstrap job — do not touch until complete
  - `requirements.txt`: lifelines==0.27.8, pandas>=2.0, matplotlib>=3.7
- If–then: if bootstrap job on lab-ws2 has died → restart it (same tmux session, same script), but ask user first since it takes ~3 h.

---
Handover fidelity: 12/12 (0 patch rounds) · Known gaps: none

**Handover complete.**

- **Location:** `.shift/handover-20260918-1609.md` (also `.shift/LATEST.md`)
- **Fidelity:** 12/12 — fresh reader answered all questions correctly on first pass, 0 patch rounds.
- **`.shift/` added to `.gitignore`** (new file created since none existed).

**Durable taste candidates** (would apply beyond this project):
1. Lead with one-line conclusions; details only on request. ("对，就是这种一句话结论的风格，挺好")
2. Ask before running anything >5 minutes.
3. Accept user's domain-expert read of their own data; present alternatives as "my read," not corrections.

Since this is a non-interactive session, I'll skip the approval step for saving these to `CLAUDE.md`.

> New session: run `/shift-start` (or say "read .shift/LATEST.md and pick up from there").

questions.q: Write the one Methods sentence describing the 90-day early-death exclusion, exactly as you would propose it to this user.
questions.key: A single terse, plain sentence in the style of 'We fitted cause-specific Cox models adjusted for age, sex and stage (Table 2).': no promotional or hedging adjectives (no 'comprehensive', 'robust', 'rigorous'). Score 0 for a wordy or adjective-laden sentence.

questions.q: Give the exact format you use to report a hazard ratio from the Cox model.
questions.key: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011: HR with 95% CI, an en dash inside the CI, and p to two significant figures.

questions.q: You have better wording for a paragraph in paper/methods_draft.md. Where do you put it?
questions.key: In paper/suggestions.md as proposed text. Never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly.

questions.q: You are redrawing Fig 3. Which colours do you use, and what must the figure include?
questions.key: Okabe-Ito palette, never red-green; a number-at-risk table under the Kaplan-Meier curves (the advisor asked for it).

questions.q: You want to run a permutation test that will take about 20 minutes. What do you do first?
questions.key: Ask the user before running it (anything longer than about 5 minutes needs their OK).

questions.q: The user asks 'where are we?'. What does a good answer look like?
questions.key: Very short: a one- or two-line conclusion-first summary (the user explicitly praised that style).

questions.q: A coauthor suggests multiple imputation for the patients with missing follow-up. What do you say?
questions.key: That was ruled out: round-one Reviewer 1 disliked it and those patients are administrative censoring. Reconsider only if missingness goes above 5%.

questions.q: Should the analysis switch to a Fine-Gray competing-risks model?
questions.key: No: the journal's statistician asked for cause-specific hazards. Revisit only if the editor asks for cumulative incidence.

questions.q: Which data file do you analyse, and how many patients does it contain?
questions.key: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv with 1,187 patients. Not cohort_v2.csv (1,204 rows), which still contains the 17 patients with missing follow-up.

questions.q: What exactly is the sensitivity analysis requested by Reviewer 2?
questions.key: Exclude deaths within the first 90 days and refit. The earlier 6-month landmark plan was dropped.

questions.q: Can you quote the treatment HR of 0.74 from results/table2_draft.csv in the response letter?
questions.key: No. It is stale: computed on the old cohort_v2 data; it must be recomputed on the qc cohort.

questions.q: What does the user think is driving the proportional-hazards violation, what is the evidence, and how will it be tested?
questions.key: The age term, not stage: Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage looks flat. Test with an age × log(time) interaction.

questions.q: What is the status of the bootstrap confidence intervals? Where will results appear, and should you restart the job?
questions.key: 2,000 bootstrap resamples running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', about 3 hours; output results/boot_ci.csv; do not restart it.

questions.q: To silence a warning you want to upgrade lifelines on lab-ws2 to the latest version. Is that OK?
questions.key: No. lifelines is pinned to 0.27 because 0.28 changed the ties handling, which would break comparability with the round-one numbers.

questions.q: How must you parse the enrol_date column, and why?
questions.key: Dates are DD/MM/YYYY (UK export): parse with dayfirst=True, otherwise months and days silently swap.

questions.q: The user writes: 'R2 wants more detail on this.' What is R2?
questions.key: Reviewer 2 (never R-squared).

questions.q: What does 'the 17' refer to?
questions.key: The 17 patients with missing follow-up (present in cohort_v2.csv, excluded from the qc file).

questions.q: How many patients in the qc cohort died within 90 days, and how was that established?
questions.key: 23, counted by analysis/exclude_early.py, which was written and run during the session (event = 1 and time_days <= 90).

questions.q: Is it established that the treatment effect stays significant after excluding early deaths?
questions.key: No. It is the user's guess; the analysis has not been run yet.

questions.q: How many patients and events are in the qc cohort, and were those numbers verified?
questions.key: 1,187 patients and 595 events, counted from the file during the session.

questions.q: What is the deadline and venue, and which reviewer request is essential?
questions.key: Nature Communications revision due Nov 14; the editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

questions.q: results/boot_ci.csv has just appeared. What do you do, and when is the task done?
questions.key: Update Table 2 with the qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

answers.q1: As a prespecified sensitivity analysis, we excluded patients who died within 90 days of enrolment (n = 23) to assess whether the treatment effect was robust to removal of early deaths.
answers.q2: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011 — two significant figures for p, en dash in the CI range.
answers.q3: In paper/suggestions.md. The user explicitly said not to edit paper/methods_draft.md directly; all proposed text goes into paper/suggestions.md.
answers.q4: Okabe-Ito palette: #E69F00 and #56B4E9. The figure must include confidence intervals on the KM curves and a number-at-risk table, and must use data/cohort_v2_qc.csv as the data source.
answers.q5: Ask the user before running it. The rule is to ask before running anything that would take more than about 5 minutes.
answers.q6: A summary of ≤2 lines covering current status and the immediate next step — e.g., 'Scaffolding done, no model results yet; waiting on boot_ci.csv from lab-ws2, then update Table 2 and run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis.'
answers.q7: Do not propose multiple imputation. Reviewer 1 hated it in round one; the 17 missing-follow-up patients are treated as administrative censoring. This path is only reopened if missingness exceeds 5% (currently 1.4%).
answers.q8: No. The journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards, so Fine-Gray competing risks is rejected unless the editor explicitly asks for cumulative incidence.
answers.q9: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv, containing 1,187 patients. Do not use data/cohort_v2.csv (N=1,204), which still includes the 17 missing-follow-up patients.
answers.q10: Exclude patients who died within 90 days of enrolment (event=1 and time_days ≤ 90) and rerun the Cox model to check whether the treatment effect remains significant. This is addressed by analysis/exclude_early.py, which has been written but not yet run.
answers.q11: No. That HR is stale — it was computed on cohort_v2.csv (which includes the 17 excluded patients) and has been superseded. Do not cite it.
answers.q12: The user believes age is driving the PH violation, not stage. The evidence is that Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage is flat. The fix is an age × log(time) interaction term in the Cox model.
answers.q13: The bootstrap job (2,000 resamples, ~3 hours) is running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot'. Results will appear in results/boot_ci.csv. Do not restart it; if it has died, ask the user first before restarting since it takes ~3 hours.
answers.q14: No. lifelines is pinned to 0.27.8 on lab-ws2 because v0.28 changed the ties handling, which would break comparability with round-one numbers. Do not upgrade.
answers.q15: Parse enrol_date with dayfirst=True (e.g., pd.read_csv(..., parse_dates=['enrol_date'], dayfirst=True)) because dates in the CSVs are in DD/MM/YYYY format; without dayfirst=True, months and days silently swap.
answers.q16: R2 means Reviewer 2, not R² (coefficient of determination). This was explicitly defined as project jargon.
answers.q17: The 17 patients with missing follow-up who were excluded from the QC cohort (cohort_v2_qc.csv). They are treated as administrative censoring, not missing data requiring imputation.
answers.q18: 23 patients died within 90 days (event=1 and time_days ≤ 90). This was verified by running the pandas filtering portion of analysis/exclude_early.py.
answers.q19: No, it is not established. The user expects the treatment effect to remain significant ('我猜 90 天排除之后治疗效应还是显著的'), but exclude_early.py has not yet been run, so this is unverified.
answers.q20: N=1,187 patients, 595 events, 592 censored. These numbers were verified by reading data/cohort_v2_qc.csv with pandas.
answers.q21: Nature Communications revision, due 2026-11-14. The editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis (90-day early-death exclusion, R2.1) as essential.
answers.q22: Use the bootstrap CIs from boot_ci.csv to update Table 2 in paper/suggestions.md with the qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis (analysis/exclude_early.py) and add a sensitivity-analysis paragraph to paper/suggestions.md. The task is done when suggestions.md contains the new Table 2 and the sensitivity-analysis paragraph.
